title: Powertoys run calculator weird behavior with space-separated thousands

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: Calculator interprets spaces as multiplication; maintainers note broad whitespace removal could break existing behavior.

next_action.label: Design locale-aware grouping parse
next_action.reason: Test unambiguous three-digit groups while preserving implicit multiplication.

judgment.rationale: The exact `100 500/100` input returns 500 because whitespace is treated as implicit multiplication, as the reporter hypothesizes and a maintainer confirms. A narrow grouping rule can be explored while preserving multiplication; regression tests must address compatibility.
evidence: Reporter expects whitespace to work as a thousands separator.
Maintainer suggests removing spaces; another notes `10 10` currently means implicit multiplication.
Issue 11786 records the same behavior and attributes it to mage interpreter.
Open issue 2265 proposes external Calculator-engine migration; maintainer says it is blocked on that project.
judgment.recommended_action: Design and test a parser rule recognizing valid three-digit grouping spaces without changing existing implied multiplication.

fix_assessment.rationale: Parser behavior is demonstrated and confirmed. A compatible distinction between grouping and multiplication is a concrete path to investigate independently of the blocked engine migration.

proposed_fixes.title: Recognize space thousands groups without changing multiplication
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The parser passes whitespace to an expression engine that interprets adjacent numeric expressions as implicit multiplication; it does not first recognize a space-delimited thousands group.
plan: Inspect Calculator tokenization/normalization and the mage handoff.
Normalize whitespace only when it unambiguously forms a locale-appropriate thousands group; preserve spaces representing implicit multiplication.
Test the reported input, spaced multiplication, repeated groups, locale, decimals, and malformed groups.
verification: Verify `100 500/100` gives 1005 when grouping is accepted for the locale.
Verify `10 10` retains existing implicit multiplication unless product direction changes.
Run Calculator parser tests and check both expressions in PowerToys Run.

confidence.rationale: Whitespace-as-multiplication is confirmed here and in #11786; accepted grouping syntax and compatibility rules need parser validation.

issue_context.summary: Calculator treats a space between number groups as multiplication, so a space-grouped expression returns 500 instead of 1005; maintainers warn broad whitespace removal changes multiplication.
known_information: Reporter expects a space as thousands separator.
Maintainers discuss removing spaces versus preserving `10 10` implicit multiplication.
Issue 11786 records the same mage whitespace-multiplication behavior.
Issue 2265 tracks an external engine migration blocked on Calculator changes.
inferences: Three-digit groups might be recognized without deleting all whitespace, but grammar and locale rules need testing.
This is a mismatch with requested grouping; ambiguous spaced-number compatibility requires care.
issue_context.analysis: Exact input/output and maintainer comments establish parser behavior. A localized normalization candidate can be tested independently of the external migration with regression coverage preserving multiplication.
initial_investigation: Read full issue and all six comments, including whitespace removal and implicit-multiplication discussion.
Reviewed #11786 and #2265; former confirms behavior, latter is an external migration with no near-term fix.
Searched related PowerToys PRs by issue number; no linked fix found.

actions.label: Design compatible thousands grouping
actions.note: Approve parser design preserving implied multiplication while testing valid grouping; this does not write upstream.

actions.label: Reproduce grouped number and multiplication cases

reproduce.title: Compare space grouping with implicit multiplication
steps: Enter `100 500/100` in PowerToys Run and record the result.
Enter `10 10` to confirm current implicit multiplication.
Repeat grouped-number case with current Windows regional format.
reproduce.expected_result: The grouped expression yields 1005 if grouping is accepted for the locale; ungrouped spaced factors retain current implicit multiplication unless maintainers choose otherwise.
